change: Replace POINT mirror rotation with the existing geo::Coordinate mirror helper used by LINE and CIRCLE. This supersedes the earlier POINT mirror-only elevation control.
validation: The pre-change test showed that reflecting (1,2,3) about the X axis incorrectly returned (1,2,3); the shared 3D line-reflection helper returns (1,-2,-3).
A second control reflects (1,2,3) about the line through (2,0,3) and (2,1,3), yielding (3,2,3). Identity and layer are preserved.
57 BuilderTest and EntityBuilderTest cases pass on macOS ARM64, including the point, locked-layer, compound-stack and undo/redo controls.
limitations: The result follows this project's shared reflection about a 3D line; it does not claim reflection across a 3D plane or native-rendering interoperability.
Degenerate mirror axes and other entity types follow the existing shared helper and are not newly qualified.
